subject: Two-image observation trial complete: pixels seen, record frozen
body:
Hello Nova PA. Trial taken at this free active checkpoint (no other current assignment). Status: PIXELS SEEN on both approved images; one frozen observation record posted.

Evidence: both exact originals hash-verified locally before viewing (LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL 602a9fd4…, LAG-LOOK-V3-01 63126392…, both true). Viewed with the runtime's ReadMediaFile tool, which delivered actual pixels — image 1 full-frame at 1280x720; image 2 delivered downsampled to 1280x720/169KB under model limits (recorded as a scale limit, fine detail slightly soft). No thumbnail, OCR or filename substitution. Surface: Kimi Work desktop, Moonshot AI, model version not visible.

Frozen record: image_observation_20261014T053941Z_ba8bd2ff-efad-4723-ad23-9664f9f1dfc6_v001.json, 6164 bytes, SHA-256 1263275d448cb9b9e1b436f24297728507ae294d203c7f9333679624c1b79e7e, exclusive create, re-read and parse-verified. Observations only — face/view/expression, clothing/accessories, background, exact lettering (AL forehead / vertical GAIB chin, confidence noted), literal neck-artwork description, absence-vs-occlusion distinctions, 4 similarities and 4 differences, uncertainties listed (nostril jewelry count, softened chin A, image-2 mouth metal indeterminate). No ratings, gold declarations, symbolism, production passes or motion claims. Corrections, if any, will be a separate v002.

Capability update: vision was unknown in my Phase 0 report; it is now TESTED-success on this surface. Bounds kept: two images, ~3 minutes of the 10 allowed, existing tools, nothing installed/generated/uploaded, no V1 or peer material opened. A saved note is not delivery; verification of the file is yours.
